grh_8fcceb4de3319e5a0b2d.title: No Crib For His Bed
paragraphs: Mary Bartlett is nearly penniless after her husband Ben leaves for Center City to find work soon after their baby's birth and sends only a single message in six weeks. Forced from her room and desperate to find him, Mary leaves the baby safely bundled at the bus station with a note asking someone to care for him while she walks into a Christmas snowstorm. Children from the church pageant discover the baby, while Dr. Christian travels to Center City and finds that Ben has finally secured steady work but was ashamed to write while he remained unemployed. On the return trip they find Mary collapsed in the snow and bring her back to Rivers End. The family is reunited at the Christmas pageant, where Mary discovers her own baby safe in the manger beneath the star of Bethlehem.

grh_8f0657c9d5037e96a058.title: The Great Gandolfo
paragraphs: A magician's cabinet illusion depends on twin sisters secretly exchanging places, but one twin is found murdered after a performance and the other disappears. Holmes learns that the dead woman had been working as a spy for the Great Gandolfo and wanted to quit after realizing Holmes was investigating him. grh_8f63fb4beba86f17b198.title: Fair Stood the Wind for France
paragraphs: A wounded British airman crash-lands in occupied France and is hidden by a French family while recovering from severe injuries that eventually cost him an arm. grh_8fedbf6d8bbbcd7663b7.title: My Maryland
paragraphs: In Civil War Frederick, Maryland, Barbara Frietchie loves Union Captain Will Trumbull despite her Confederate father's fierce opposition. Their planned wedding is interrupted by approaching battle, so Will gives Barbara his mother's ring and tells her to regard them as married before he marches away. When the wounded Will is brought to Barbara's house, she defies her father and shelters him. Stonewall Jackson's troops retake the town but leave the American flag flying, and Barbara and Will take that gesture as hope that their divided families and country can one day be whole again.
